text: Yes, tree-cover loss on this property has been increasing in recent years. Between 2021 and 2023, the property experienced a total of 86.4 hectares (ha) of tree-cover loss, with the majority occurring in 2021 (81.3 ha), followed by 2023 (4.5 ha), and a minimal loss in 2022 (0.6 ha). This trend shows a significant increase compared to the pre-2020 period, where annual losses were around 1-2 ha. The data indicates a notable spike in 2021, suggesting an upward trajectory in recent years.
